items.summary: Recommendation: keep the Black Market Apparel capsule prototype out of the implementation queue pending the CFO report-only baseline. The proposed prototype is technically isolatable and reversible, but site-level revenue, attribution, contribution margin, and cost-to-learn are not supported by current evidence. Approve only the bounded report-only reconciliation, using existing telemetry and cost records; do not add tracking, alter affiliate configuration, deploy, or spend. Reassess the capsule after the report records eligible sessions, outbound clicks, site-attributed orders, shipped items, commission, AI cost, infrastructure allocation, and other available direct costs, with unavailable fields explicitly labeled.

Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private. No technical release or public-beta work is safe to queue while source rights, accuracy/freshness, security, privacy, measurement, and attribution gates remain incomplete. The existing owner decision remains limited to authorizing preparation of an unsent permission request or ending the public-beta pursuit.
